summary: Implemented KAFKA-20623 by sanitizing error messages in the topology description plugin deletion path to prevent leaking raw plugin internals to clients. All required functionality (plugin integration, heartbeat post-processing, exponential backoff, RPC handlers, metadata persistence, and delete integration) was already present in the codebase. The single change sanitizes error messages in StreamsGroupTopologyDescriptionManager.toFailureEntry() to return a generic message instead of raw plugin exceptions, improving security while maintaining proper error semantics.
